# Davy

> One self-hosted binary that replaces Sentry and Better Stack: error tracking with the official Sentry SDKs, logs from Logtail shippers, OpenTelemetry and Vercel Log Drains, uptime checks, alerts, and MCP so coding agents read errors and logs and mark issues fixed.

To install Davy and connect an app, follow docs/install.md from top to bottom. Every step has one command, what it prints when it works, and what to do when it does not. Ask the person only for the public URL and, optionally, an SMTP server.

## Install

- [Install](docs/install.md): download and verify the binary, create its user, run `davy setup`, start the service, add TLS, check with `davy doctor`.
- [Docker](docs/docker.md): the signed image, a volume for the data, TLS through a proxy, backups and upgrades.

## Connect

- [Node](docs/connect/node.md): errors from `@sentry/node`, only the DSN changes.
- [Browser JavaScript](docs/connect/browser.md): errors from `@sentry/browser` and source maps uploaded with `sentry-cli`.
- [Python](docs/connect/python.md): errors from `sentry-sdk`.
- [Go](docs/connect/go.md): errors from `sentry-go`.
- [Logs from pino and Logtail shippers](docs/connect/logtail.md): change the endpoint and the source token.
- [OpenTelemetry logs](docs/connect/opentelemetry.md): two environment variables for the OTLP exporter.
- [Vercel Log Drains](docs/connect/vercel.md): a custom endpoint, the key in a header and an optional signature secret.
- [Coding agents](docs/connect/agents.md): MCP for Claude Code, Codex and Cursor with `davy mcp-config`.

## Reference

- [Design](docs/design.md): what each part does and why, milestone by milestone.
- [Architecture](docs/architecture.md): how the binary is built inside.
- [Security](SECURITY.md): how to report a vulnerability and what Davy defends against.
- [Roadmap](roadmap.json): what shipped, with its version and date, what is being built and what comes next.

## Connect a new app

Run `davy connect SLUG --data DATA --sdk PLATFORM` on the Davy host. It
creates or reuses a project and prints JSON with the DSN, SDK install and
init, an uncommitted DSN location and a test-event shell command. Use
`--local` only for apps on that host. Execute the test command and poll MCP
`project_status(slug)` for an increased event count. Then trigger an SDK
error and check again. MCP `connect_project(slug, sdk?)` reads the same
instructions for existing projects; creating keys requires the local CLI.
See [the agent flow](docs/connect/agents.md#connect-a-new-app).

- [Android](docs/connect/android.md): Kotlin setup, offline caching and mapping limits.
- [Rust](docs/connect/rust.md): sentry 0.49 builder and tracing error layer.
- [.NET](docs/connect/dotnet.md): ASP.NET Core and an empty DSN fallback.
